title: AI Product Manager Graduate (TikTok-Product-Content Ecosystem) - 2027 Start

deadline.evidence: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

application_cap.evidence: Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply.

materials_required.evidence: Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

start_date.evidence: Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year.

degree_requirement.value: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, information management, data science or related discipline
degree_requirement.evidence: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, information management, data science or a related discipline.

responsibilities: drive content understanding and classification across TikTok's global ecosystem
improve accuracy, scalability, and coverage of AI-powered content detection systems
collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify gaps and define product solutions
translate business needs and regional requirements into product roadmaps
build core product capabilities such as multimodal understanding and data pipelines
define evaluation frameworks and run experiments to improve model performance
